spans.s:
नीथ, अस्, m. (Ved. also n.) leading, guiding;
a leader, a guider; N. of a man; (आ), f., Ved. way,
trick; evasion, subterfuge; a mode in music; water;
[cf. दीर्घ-न्˚, देव-न्˚.]
—नीथा-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
knowing ways, knowing the musical modes, skilled
in sacred song.
नीथ; after ‘subterfuge’ insert (अम्), n. a hymn.
